title: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss
summary: For a finite p -group G and a subgroup H , we prove that the optimal chromatic fixed-point loss equals the shortest length of a subnormal chain from H to G with cyclic quotients. The equality holds at every prime and every nonnegative height, resolving positively the equality proposed by Kuhn and Lloyd.
family_title: Cyclic length and chromatic fixed-point loss

review.reason: Relates optimal chromatic fixed-point loss in p-groups to subnormal chains with cyclic quotients.
